title: Execute staged rule graphs with explicit conflict composition
summary: Build a small typed rule planner and executor. Preserve dependencies between association, evidence, consequence, and attention while permitting bounded concurrency for genuinely independent work.
in_scope: Deterministic conflict resolvers and shared budgets
implementation: Compile typed dependency edges and validate conditional cycles and accepted predecessor states.
Schedule independent nodes within shared limits and build dependent inputs only after qualification.
Record skipped, blocked, cancelled, and unresolved paths with actual input references.
Apply explicit conflict resolvers, preserving original disagreement and mandatory gates.

acceptance.criterion: A recovery judgment receives the validated selected candidate.
acceptance.verification: Use a two-stage evaluator that asserts its input revision.

acceptance.criterion: Independent completion order does not change deterministic composition.
acceptance.verification: Permute worker completion under fixed conflict policy.

acceptance.criterion: Unqualified predecessors block required descendants without implying false conclusions.
acceptance.verification: Inject ambiguous, expired, and timed-out predecessors.

tests: Conflicting qualified answers remain inspectable when quiet.
Concurrent nodes share remaining call budget.
High impact cannot offset failed source coverage.
risks: Batching dependent questions can produce plausible answers from inputs never supplied.

reuse.application: Implement explicit dependent stages with logical composition in ordinary code.
